title: Replicating METR's Agent Monitoring Vulnerability Discovery at Smaller Scale

original_idea.body:
# Replicating METR's Agent Monitoring Vulnerability Discovery at Smaller Scale

**Problem:** METR found novel vulnerabilities in Anthropic's production agent monitoring systems. It is unknown whether similar vulnerability patterns exist in open-source agent monitoring solutions.

**Direction:** Take an open-source agent monitoring framework (e.g., Langfuse, Helicone). Systematically apply the vulnerability categories identified by METR (as reported). Test whether any of the same vulnerability classes are present. Document findings as a security audit report.

**Why it matters:** If open-source monitoring tools have similar vulnerability patterns as the proprietary system METR audited, the entire ecosystem of agent monitoring may be systematically weak.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 monitoring vulnerabilities; open-source agent observability tools; security audit methodology.
